label: Khuruud
note: Aarts (pressed curd) dried in the sun until rock-hard; a modern version presses unfermented curds in moulds; aaruul is the softer sweetened, sliced version of the same curd

how.label: press, dry hard
how.text: Milk is soured, the curds drained (chagaa) and pressed in sacks under weight into semi-solid aarts; sun-dried it becomes khuruud, a rock-hard cheese; ground through a meat grinder with sugar it becomes aaruul.
